newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam fraud trial hears call for death sentence.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam fraud trial hears call for death sentence.

text.p: Prosecutors in southern Vietnam's Ho Chi Minh City have called for death sentences in the country's biggest fraud trial.
Court officials said on Monday that the trial, into its fifth day, was likely to end on Tuesday with two of the eight defendants sentenced to execution by firing squad and a life term for one other.

The trial, being billed as the communist country's biggest ever fraud case, involves accusations of embezzlement and cheating involving state officials and others, and more than $12 million in cash and gold.
But the lead suspect, Tran Xuan Hoa, has not been present. Police said she fled across the border into Cambodia in 1994 as the investigation closed in around her.
Vietnam's state-controlled media has given prominence to the case, apparently reflecting current political concerns over widespread corruption.
